name: cjm-workflow-hub-tui
summary: Workspace front door for cjm-substrate workflows: collection-grouped source browser with stage-at-a-glance pipeline status, launch into the right stage TUI, and the collection curation surface (confirm / rename / refile / order / merge by title identity). Workflow-agnostic by charter; the transcription vertical is the first shipped workflow, with more source types (video, epub, code) joining the same hub as they become workflows. Born on-graph.
